{{Quote|Hello there! I am a distributor of unique and interesting art, and I have a limited time offer you might be interested in.|Navari Trik|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>}}
'''Navari Trik''' was a distributor of [[Painting/Legends|paintings]].

==Biography==
[[File:Navari.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Navari Trik and her paintings]]
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], she was tasked with distributing [[Painting/Legends|paintings]] selected in [[Galactic Empire Painting Contest]], as well as secretly distributing [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] paintings from the [[Rebel Alliance Painting Contest]].

She set up shop near the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Cantina]] for a short time, distributing paintings to a number of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]]. Two paintings of note that she distributed were, [[United in Our Cause|''United in our Cause'']] and ''[[The March to Restuss]]''.

She later made a return, distributing two other paintings titled ''[[Imperial Oasis Incident]]'' and ''[[Preparing for the Storm]]'' in front of the [[Spaceport/Legends|Mos Eisley Spaceport]].

==Behind the scenes==
Navari Trik was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. During Game Update 5, players could obtain paintings from her in Mos Eisley. These paintings were created by players and voted on by the playerbase.

She once again made another appearance during Game Update 14, handing out two others free of charge. Just like before, these two paintings were created by players, and voted on by the playerbase on the ''Star Wars Galaxies'' message board.
